warnings.noDirectory: Chat Reactions | Custom emojis are off because no emoji folder is set. A GM can choose a folder with emoji images in Configure Settings → Chat Reactions → Custom Emojis Directory.
warnings.noFileBrowser: Chat Reactions | Custom emojis and emoji packs are hidden for you: they need the "{permission}" permission. Ask the GM to grant it to your role in Configure Permissions.

emojipleter.name: Enable Emojipleter
emojipleter.hint: Shows possible emoji completions when typing a colon in chat.

emojipleterMaxResults.name: Emojipleter Max Results
emojipleterMaxResults.hint: The maximum number of emoji search results to show in the emojipleter.

chatReactionsDirectory.name: Custom Emojis Directory
chatReactionsDirectory.hint: You can add more custom emojis for your players to interact with!

compactReactionButton.name: Compact Reaction Button
compactReactionButton.hint: Before any reactions are added to the message, this replaces the add reaction button with a small button in the message header next to the delete button for adding the first reaction so reaction-less messages won't take up extra space.

compactEmojiButton.name: Compact Emoji Button
compactEmojiButton.hint: Shows the add emoji button next to the chat input as a small smiley icon.

pickerBackground.name: Picker Background Color
pickerBackground.hint: The background of the emoji picker. Left at its default, the picker follows Foundry's theme.

pickerText.name: Picker Text Color
pickerText.hint: The text of the emoji picker. Left at its default, the picker follows Foundry's theme.

pickerAccent.name: Picker Accent Color
pickerAccent.hint: The selected category and the focus outline in the emoji picker. Left at its default, the picker follows Foundry's theme.

frequentCount.name: Frequently Used Emojis
frequentCount.hint: How many of your most used emojis the picker shows first, up to 16 (two rows). 0 hides them.

showPreview.name: Show Preview
showPreview.hint: Shows the emoji under the pointer, with its name, at the bottom of the picker.

showCategory.name: Show Category: {category}
showCategory.hint: Shows the {category} emojis in the picker.

picker.label: Emoji Picker
picker.dataError: The emoji data could not be loaded.
